Method of Attack: Encrypts files on all drives and volumes (both local and networked)
Creates multiple threads for encrypting files
Terminates processes and services to reduce the number of files locked by other programs
Enumerates and mounts volumes to encrypt the files on these volumes
Deletes volume snapshots by resizing the allocated space for snapshots of volume shadow copies
Impacted Systems: Files with extensions .exe, .dll, or .lnk are skipped
Directories and sub-directories excluded based on hardcoded hashes
Attack Vector: Command line options for customized executions (-help, -network, -file filePath, -dir dirPath)
Administrator privileges required for full functionality
Indicators of Compromise: Files encrypted and appended with a .NOKOYAWA extension
Ransom note written into NOKOYAWA_readme.txt in every directory included for encryption
